name: EntityReach Corporate Group Intelligence
short_description: Enterprise account-research resources, product information and reproducible corporate-group samples.
description: Read EntityReach product capabilities, pricing and access requirements; find public account-research guides and integration resources; analyse a reproducible static Alphabet corporate-group sample. The public endpoint has three read-only tools and needs no account or API key. Live company search, profiles, corporate groups and contact previews use a separate activated workspace and scoped EntityReach key. Coverage and fields vary by company and jurisdiction. A group relationship does not establish buying intent or procurement independence.
